messages:
Aria: 09:12 UTC  Were seeing a tenant activation slowdown in eu-central where some setups hang on 'processing assets'. Opening thread to coordinate customer notices and triage. See INC-4512 internal doc.

Ben: Support shows ~29 queued activations; 6 flagged as renewal-risk (next 30d). Majority stall during schema validation.

Soraya: Quick tech note  earlier schema tightening caused increased validation time under concurrency. Rolled a soft relax at 09:40 UTC and scaled the activations workers. That halted new failures but backlog must drain.

Ethan: Mitigations: scaled workers + temporary fallback ingest path; increased retry backoff windows. Prioritizing reserved pools and accounts with renewal Q1/Q2. ETA to clear backlog ~5 hours at current throughputs.

Aria: Customer comms plan (first message by 09:50 UTC): one-line status, ETA, link to status page, two EU office hour slots, one-time credit and free enablement offer, and a 1-question feedback form. Draft below.

Aria: Draft message: "Hi <CustomerName>, we're investigating an activation issue in EU that may cause tenant setups to stall at 'processing assets'. We've applied mitigations and expect most activations to complete within 4-6 hours. We're prioritizing enterprise and soon-to-renew accounts. Office hours: 10:30 & 16:00 CET. Reply to request a 1:1 and we'll prioritize you. One-time account credit and a complimentary enablement session will be provided. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/INC-4512"

Ben: LGTM. I'll send personalized notes to the 6 enterprise contacts and run a bulk to the remainder. Will escalate any replies that mention delaying renewal.

Soraya: I'll draft the brief RCA and list of follow-ups for the postmortem  adding canary activation tests and an alert for activation-hang > 3min.

Ethan: Impacted tenant export done (29 tenants). DMing secure link to Aria and Ben. Included renewal quarter and priority tags.

status-bot: Incident INC-4512: mitigations partial. Backlog draining. Next update scheduled 10:30 UTC.

Aria: Thanks everyone. Keep customer replies short in this thread so CS can copy-paste. If you see churn language, tag the AE and ping me.

Ben: Bulk send started 09:48 UTC. Two customers requested immediate 1:1s; marking as high-priority. Delivery shows ~90% delivered, a few invalid contacts to hand off to AEs.

Soraya: Backlog improving to ~10 activations/min. If stable, estimated clear in ~4-5 hours. I'll post if anything regresses.

Aria: Good work team  I'll assemble an exec note once the RCA draft is ready. Closing coordination here for now; continue posting customer feedback and renewal signals.

status-bot: Next automated update at 10:30 UTC.
file_note: cs incident comms: eu activation slowdown
